findings.message_plain: mods holds 3 records able to carry a tag, and none of them declares one. Nothing here is malformed — an untagged node is a store nobody has curated yet, not a defect — but every `ks brief --tag` at this node returns nothing for it, whatever a reader asks for. Tagging even one record clears this on the next run; the `tag-backfill` skill is built for tagging a whole node at once rather than one record at a time.

a team home's document — the team's own directory, which the tagging backfill never reaches, so one tagged there must not make an uncurated node read as curated

findings.message_plain: The term `reflection` in mods/detect-any-element is declared by exactly one record. A term one record carries sorts nothing: every query for it returns that record, which whoever wrote it could already find, and a vocabulary made of those is a list rather than an index.
